verdict.rationale: The IRS offers machine channels such as MeF XML transmission and IRIS A2A, so asking whether integrators can test in a sandbox is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a test environment, assurance-testing mode, or any other way to exercise these channels without touching production filings. The MeF and IRIS citations describe only production intake gated by credentials, so the verdict is none.
